reason: v104 retained the original blockout and its shape change was insufficient. This revision builds new sculpture geometry rather than remeshing that head/body.
construction: Independent Blender surfaces for head/face/eyes/ears/neck, curls/scalp, robe torso, sleeves/forearms, two folded leg masses, lotus and aureole. Only connected anatomical hand surfaces are reused and scaled at their wrists.
changes: Broader facial silhouette and jaw, half-open lens geometry, nose wings and full lips, attached elongated ears, short ringed neck, broader robe torso, fuller sleeves, separated crossed legs, pointed lotus surfaces and new flat gilt backing.
